Title: The GS5 Azure Virtual Machines will no longer be SAP HANA Certified on 28 February 2022

Body.Content:
We know that it is important to have an SAP HANA Certified Azure VM to ensure your SAP workloads achieve the performance and reliability required. We identified E64ds_v4 to be the ideal Azure VM for your SAP HANA workloads as the GS5 Azure VMs will no longer be SAP HANA Certified on 28 February 2022. 

Action required 

If you are not running SAP HANA, there is no action you need to take.   

If you are running SAP HANA, please transition to the E64ds_v4 Azure VM before 28 February 2022. Please stop your current G/GS5 VMs and follow the instructions to resize your VMs: Azure Virtual Machine Windows VM and/or Linux VM. View Windows VM pricing for E64ds_v4. View Linux VM pricing for E64ds_v4. 

More information  

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A . If you have a support question and you need technical help, please create a support request.
